facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy says it created digital addressing in 2023 with a total of 132,937 addresses in Banjul, KMC and Brikama (Kombo North).

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

GMB.note: Document states no digital-skills training for civil servants.
Government web hosting and email service is stated, but no hosting or cloud policy.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy says the National Cybersecurity committee was inaugurated in 2023, to be responsible for coordination, resource mobilization and advice.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

GMB.note: Document states no public digital-skills programme or measured share.
Document names no online government service; hosting, email and addressing are not services people complete online.

facts.fact: The Ministry says the Gambia's telecommunications infrastructure includes the ACE (Africa Coast to Europe) submarine cable; a second submarine cable is described as funded at USD 25 million through the World Bank's WARDIP, not in service.

GMB.note: Document states no school internet share or compulsory curriculum.
